lines.rom: sri ganapati pada naya sira dhari hiya sarada dhyana santosi mam ki karum kirati sakala bakhana
jaya samtosi mam jaga janani khala mati dusta daitya dala hanani
ganapati deva tumhare tata riddhi siddhi kahalavaham mata
mata pita ki rahau dulari kirati kehi vidhi kahum tumhari
krita mukuta sira anupama bhari kanana kundala ko chavi nyari
sohata amga chata chavi pyari sundara cira sunahari dhari
apa caturbhuja sughara visala dharana karahu gale vana mala
nikata hai gau amita dulari karahu mayura apa asavari
janata sabahi apa prabhutai sura nara muni saba karahim barai

veda purana rahe yasa gai karahu bhakta ki apa sahai
brahma dhimga sarasvati kahai laksmi rupa visnu dhimga ai
